Episode details
Radio 5 Live,24 Nov 2026,18 mins
Freddie Potts on leaving West Ham, life in Belgium and beating Inter Milan
Euro Leagues
Available for over a year
Freddie Potts discusses his new life in Bruges with John Bennett after leaving West Ham after 16 years. From family visits to the city as a youngster and now watching West Ham from afar – Potts opens up about life in Belgium. He also discusses winning at Inter Milan, their match against Liverpool next week and the language in the dressing room. 0 mins – Settling in and the decision to join Club Brugge. 2 mins – Culture shocks and language, the attraction of living in Bruges. 3 mins – The language in the dressing room. 4 mins – Visiting Bruges as a child around Christmas and a photo of a cardboard cutout of the team with Potts while visiting the city. 6 mins – The relationship with his dad now he is not with him at West Ham any longer. 7 mins – Achieving your dreams playing for West Ham and being there for 16 years. And trying to watch as many of their games as possible now he has left. 9 mins – The standard in the Belgium league. 10 mins – Potts gives some insight into Nicola Tresoldi. 12 mins – Playing in the Champions League and winning at Inter Milan. Their ambitions in the competition for this season. 15 mins – Playing against Liverpool in the Champions League on Wednesday. 16 mins – Would Potts recommend other young English players move abroad? 17 mins – Potts’ favourite place in Bruges.

פרדי פוטס התארח בפודקאסט ספורט כדי לדון בחייו החדשים בבלגיה לאחר שעזב את קבוצת וסטהאם שבה שיחק במשך 16 שנים. פוטס שוחח על ההחלטה להצטרף לקלאב ברוז', ההתמודדות עם אתגרי השפה והתרבות השונה, ועל תחושתו בעקבות ניצחון יוקרתי על אינטר מילאן במסגרת ליגת האלופות.

בנוסף, פוטס התייחס ליחסיו עם אביו לאחר הפרידה המקצועית מווסטהאם, לקשיי המעבר וההתרגלות לרמה בליגה הבלגית, ולקראת ההתמודדות הצפויה של קבוצתו מול ליברפול במפעל האירופי.
